mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% (FEDFUNDS <= 0.5%) predicts positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns due to compressed discount rates and increased liquidity in the financial system.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% (based on a rolling 3-year window).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.3 percentage points over the past three months signals improving labor market conditions, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when UNRATE declines by more than 0.3pp over 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month increases in housing starts (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) by more than 0.5% indicate robust consumer demand, supporting corporate revenue growth and driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both rise > 0.5% MoM
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS rise by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average signals supply constraints that may lead to inflation and reduced corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are negative in less than 55% of instances when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL index above 220 (indicating annual inflation exceeding 2.5% relative to 1982-1984) predicts negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns due to anticipated monetary tightening and reduced real rates.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 220.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts (HOUST) level below 500.0 thousand units signals a contraction in the residential sector, reducing consumer confidence and corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 5-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns are negative in less than 55% of instances when HOUST < 500.0.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous month-over-month growth in payroll employment (PAYEMS > 0.5%) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE < -0.2pp) indicate a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 20-day forward returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp MoM
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns are positive in less than 55% of instances when PAYEMS rises > 0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls > 0.2pp MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Negative quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1 < 0%) signals a recession, leading to reduced corporate profits and negative S&P 500 60-day forward returns.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns are negative in less than 55% of instances when GDPC1 growth is negative.
